tools.name: search_claims
tools.description: Search PIPD's fact-checked answers to common claims and myths about Palestine and Israel; use it for any question about such a claim. Returns the closest matching claims, best first, each with PIPD's full answers, sources and page URL, or an empty list with a note when nothing matches.

tools.name: get_claim
tools.description: Fetch one PaliAnswers claim by its id or slug, for example one listed by list_claims; give exactly one of id or slug. Returns the claim with PIPD's full answers, sources, themes and page URL.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List the themes PaliAnswers groups its claims under; use it to browse or to pick a theme for list_claims. Returns each theme's name, number of claims and page URL.

tools.name: list_claims
tools.description: List every claim PaliAnswers answers, or only those in one theme; use it to browse, then get_claim for full answers. Returns each claim's id, text and page URL.
